searchText: Eth2 call this Thursday! https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/89 I was told that the ETH2 deposit contract is on an indefinite hold because we are going to wait on IETF to standardize BLS signatures Is that correct? Waiting on standards bodies = waiting on Godot, IMO Not indefinite, the BLS standardization working group is positive about progress: the draft is there, and they actively work to get it standardized. <@438324482306998273> We are actually waiting on a "blockchain agreement" about the standard, which from my understanding is pretty much here. A handful of blockchains are going to commit to a standard soon before the final ietf, assuming that the ietf draft will be stable and that we at least get our own standard if the ietf one changes ok that sounds better what is the date?
